hero.headline: Discover Things to Do in Addis Ababa
hero.subheadline: From city tours and day trips to must-see landmarks, find experiences that match your interests and schedule.

items.title: Half-Day City Tour
items.description: Explore Addis Ababa's highlights in half a day — National Museum, Merkato, and cultural landmarks with a local guide.

items.title: Full-Day City Tour
items.description: A comprehensive full-day tour covering all major attractions, local markets, and cultural experiences.

items.title: Addis Ababa Highlights Tour
items.description: See the best of Addis Ababa in a single day — perfect for first-time visitors with limited time.

items.title: Debre Libanos & Portuguese Bridge
items.description: Visit the 13th-century Debre Libanos Monastery and the dramatic Portuguese Bridge on a full-day excursion.

items.title: Tiya, Adadi Mariam & Melka Kunture
items.description: Explore UNESCO World Heritage stelae, an ancient rock-hewn church, and prehistoric archaeological sites.

items.title: Menagesha Forest Day Trip
items.description: Escape to the ancient Menagesha Forest for hiking, birdwatching, and mountain scenery.

items.title: Bishoftu Crater Lakes
items.description: Visit the stunning crater lakes of Bishoftu for scenic views and lakeside relaxation.

items.title: National Museum of Ethiopia
items.description: Home to Lucy (Dinkinesh) and extensive Ethiopian art and archaeological collections.

items.title: Holy Trinity Cathedral
items.description: Ethiopia's most important cathedral, final resting place of Emperor Haile Selassie.

items.title: Merkato
items.description: Africa's largest open-air market — a sensory experience of spices, coffee, textiles, and local life.

cta.headline: Need Help Choosing?
cta.subheadline: Not sure which tour or experience is right for you? Our local team can help you plan the perfect Addis Ababa visit.
